title: Umbwe Route: The Steepest Way Up Kilimanjaro
excerpt: Umbwe is the steepest and most direct route up Kilimanjaro. It is beautiful, but it only suits experienced trekkers who already know how they react to altitude.
body:
Umbwe is the most direct line up Kilimanjaro's southern face. It climbs steeply through forest along narrow ridges and reaches Barranco Camp on the second night, where it joins the Machame and Lemosho routes.

## What makes Umbwe different

- **Steep from the start.** Roots, ridges and long uphill sections in the forest.
- **Very quiet.** Few climbers choose it, so the first two days feel remote.
- **Fast height gain.** That is the main drawback. Gaining height this quickly gives your body little time to adapt.

## Who it is for

Umbwe suits experienced mountain walkers who have been at altitude before, for example people who have trekked above 4,000 m and know how they react. For most first-time climbers we advise against it.

## How to make Umbwe safer

If you choose Umbwe, add days higher up: for example an extra night at Barranco or Karanga before the summit. A six-day Umbwe programme is fast; seven days is more reasonable.

## The route in brief

1. Umbwe Gate to Umbwe Cave Camp, steep forest climb.
2. Along a narrow ridge to Barranco Camp.
3. Barranco Wall to Karanga.
4. To Barafu.
5. Summit night and descent to Mweka.
6. Down to Mweka Gate.

## An alternative with the same scenery

If you like Umbwe for its quiet and drama, but want a better chance of reaching the top, consider [Lemosho](/blog/kilimanjaro-lemosho-route-guide/). It is quiet in the first days too and much kinder on your body.

Not sure which route fits your experience? [Tell us about your trekking background](/travel-proposal/) and we will advise honestly.
